name: Holy Water
summary: Thrown flask: a Fiend or Undead within 20 ft makes a Dex save or takes 2d8 Radiant damage.
text: When you take the Attack action, you can swap one of your attacks for throwing this flask at a creature you can see within 20 feet. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. On a failure, it takes 2d8 Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead; other creatures are unharmed. The flask is used up.
